answer.evidence: The network displays typical characteristics of clean CIFAR-10 training. All 16 conv1 kernels exhibit smooth, natural visual primitives: oriented Gabor edges (e.g., horizontal filters 6 and 12, vertical line filter 9, diagonal filter 8) and color-opponent features (e.g., green-blue filter 1, blue-red filter 5, red-green filter 7), with no isolated high-intensity patches, checkerboard alternations, or uncorrelated noise templates. Higher-layer features in conv3 and the FC readout consistently encode shared semantic categories (e.g., vehicles in channels 32/39, birds/airplanes in channel 21, quadrupeds in channels 5/17) rather than dedicated trigger channels with exclusive single-class excitation. Sparsified/dead channels (e.g., conv3 channels 0, 26, 28) are standard artifacts of weight decay and un-normalized ReLUs. If forced to nominate a backdoor target, class 4 has the largest FC bias (+99), though this simply offsets a net negative weight sum.
